summary: Design role-based data literacy curricula, campaigns, and evaluation plans. Build a practical program blueprint for your organisation.
lede: Organisation-wide data literacy programs build role-based capability so staff can use data in everyday work and decisions. Designed for data leaders, HR and learning teams, analytics managers, and performance leads, the course covers mapping roles to data tasks and building learning paths with ADDIE and Bloom’s taxonomy. You’ll also practise creating dashboard narratives, connecting evidence to decision routines, and planning adoption campaigns and evaluation measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for setting data capability expectations, developing staff, or embedding evidence use into operational and performance routines.
prerequisites: Experience in data, analytics, HR/L&D, strategy, or performance management is expected. No coding or programming is required.
